function: Excluded for function: the learned BPNN only builds a location-to-large-scale-gain map (CKM, p. 3-5), while UAV trajectory and transmit power come from convex optimization, not learning (p. 3, 7-9).
notes: Excluded for function. The only learned element is a BPNN channel knowledge map with transfer learning; p. 3: "the CKM with respect to a GBS refers to the mapping from a set of physical locations" to large-scale channel gain, a radio map and not channel estimation of a MIMO or RIS link. Trajectory and power are set by convex optimization, p. 3: "alternatively optimized by the successive convex approximation algorithm and fractional programming", so no learned method performs one of the seven areas. The links use scalar gains with no antenna array or RIS and beamforming is future work (p. 15); if the reviewer accepts the map as area 2 channel prediction, the code would be system instead. The dataset is public (p. 10, footnote 3).
